# Web Design Guidelines — Portable Fallback

Use for UI/UX/accessibility review.

## Review dimensions

- semantic structure;
- keyboard/focus behavior;
- labels/errors/forms;
- contrast and readable type;
- responsive layout;
- touch target/interaction feedback;
- loading/empty/error states;
- consistency and hierarchy;
- motion/reduced-motion;
- content clarity.

Use current standards/browser behavior where exact requirements matter.

Do not infer compliance from component-library choice alone.

Report concrete page/component evidence and remediation priority.
